task.description: WF-03 Step 03: Implement the approved fix per src/design/onboarding-e2e-nav-fix.md. This is a Category E single-file test-harness rewrite. Replace the racy `navigateSpa` in web/tests/e2e/pipeline.ts (current: history.pushState + synthetic popstate) with a page.goto-based implementation per the design artefact. Signature must remain `export async function navigateSpa(page: Page, targetPath: string): Promise<void>` — backward compatible for all 8 callers. Do NOT modify production source files. Do NOT touch the 6 local-shadowing copies (out of scope). Reference proven pattern at web/tests/e2e/tenants.e2e.spec.ts:74-79. After implementation: run lint_frontend_conventions.py and lint_test_isolation.py (both must exit 0 with no BLOCKER/MAJOR), npm run type-check (exit 0), npm run lint (exit 0). Then commit to feature/WF03-onboarding-e2e-fix-20260614 with message 'fix(WF03): rewrite navigateSpa to use page.goto (ISS-0069)'.
acceptance_criteria: navigateSpa rewritten to use page.goto + page.waitForURL per design
Signature unchanged: navigateSpa(page: Page, targetPath: string): Promise<void>

result.summary: Rewrote navigateSpa in web/tests/e2e/pipeline.ts to use page.goto(targetPath, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' }) + page.waitForURL(matcher, { timeout: 10_000 }) instead of the racy history.pushState + synthetic popstate pattern. Signature unchanged (export async function navigateSpa(page: Page, targetPath: string): Promise<void>), so all 8 importing callers continue to compile and work without edits. Mirrors the proven pattern at web/tests/e2e/tenants.e2e.spec.ts:74-79. loginWithToken's addInitScript re-runs on every goto, so the E2E session is re-injected automatically — auth is preserved. Single file changed. Commit 202d74d pushed to feature/WF03-onboarding-e2e-fix-20260614.
